Name: Koobi Fora
AlternativeTaxonomy: Classic Homo ergaster site; often classified under Homo erectus sensu lato.

Name: Ubeidiya
AlternativeTaxonomy: Early Eurasian migration site; hominin remains and Acheulean tools are closely associated with Homo ergaster.

Name: Dmanisi
AlternativeTaxonomy: Also classified as Homo georgicus or a transitional form of African/Eurasian Homo ergaster.

Name: Mojokerto
AlternativeTaxonomy: Early Asian Homo erectus; direct descendant of the early Homo ergaster Out of Africa I dispersal.

Name: Ternifine
AlternativeTaxonomy: Originally described as Atlanthropus mauritanicus; often grouped within Homo heidelbergensis or African Homo erectus (sensu lato).

Name: Buia
AlternativeTaxonomy: Transition fossil often linked to early Homo heidelbergensis or African Homo erectus (sensu lato), sometimes associated with Danakil hominin variants.

Name: Bouri
AlternativeTaxonomy: Key African Homo erectus (sensu lato) specimen bridging early H. ergaster and later Middle Pleistocene hominins; shares strong morphological affinities with Asian H. erectus and Buia.

Name: Mauer
AlternativeTaxonomy: Type specimen (holotype Mauer 1) of Homo heidelbergensis; alternatively classified as European Homo erectus heidelbergensis or archaic Homo sapiens.

Name: Yunxian
AlternativeTaxonomy: Show a mixture of features associated both with Homo erectus and with 'archaic H. sapiens'

Name: Lantian
AlternativeTaxonomy: Subspecies Homo erectus lantianensis; originally described as Sinanthropus lantianensis; morphologically archaic East Asian Homo erectus with small cranial capacity.

Name: Peking Man (Zhoukoudian)
AlternativeTaxonomy: Subspecies Homo erectus pekinensis; originally described as Sinanthropus pekinensis; classic East Asian Homo erectus (sensu stricto) exemplar.

Name: Sangiran 17
AlternativeTaxonomy: Pithecanthropus erectus; classic East Asian Homo erectus (sensu stricto). Includes famous specimen Sangiran 17 (S17) — the most complete Javanese hominin cranium.

Name: Trinil
AlternativeTaxonomy: Originally described as Pithecanthropus erectus ('Java Man'); classic East Asian Homo erectus (sensu stricto). Associated with the Trinil 2 calotte specimen.

Name: Olorgesailie
AlternativeTaxonomy: African Homo erectus (sensu lato); associated with advanced Acheulean technology and transitional mid-Pleistocene hominins, sometimes linked to early Homo heidelbergensis or regional African variants.

Name: Konso
AlternativeTaxonomy: African Homo erectus (sensu lato) / Homo ergaster; crucial East African paleoanthropological site yielding robust hominin crania and early technological transitions.

Name: Gran Dolina
AlternativeTaxonomy: Also classified as Homo antecessor by discoverers; represents early European Homo heidelbergensis (sensu lato) or a regional transitional form from European Homo erectus.

Name: Happisburgh
AlternativeTaxonomy: Earliest known human occupation site in Northern Europe; associated with early tool-makers, sometimes linked to Homo antecessor or ancestral European Homo heidelbergensis (sensu lato).
